content: Commercial anomaly tools (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, GA4) universally expose a sensitivity slider/preset (loose/tight band around expected signal) mapped internally to detector thresholds, with an advanced/expert mode for direct parameter access. Some also offer 'auto-adaptive' default. This validates a Low/Med/High preset + Advanced-toggle pattern mapped to underlying algorithm params (e.g. contamination rate, z-threshold, window size).
